spans.s: भिल् r. 10 cl. (भेलयति-ते) To divide or separate.

भिल्ल् m. (-ल्लः) A barbarian of a particular tribe, perhaps the modern
Bheel, a savage race dwelling especially along the course of the
Narmadā, and subsisting chiefly by plunder.
भीलु mfn. (-लुः-लुः or लूः-लु) Timid, fearful: see भीरु.

भीलु(लू)क mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Timid, fearful.
 m. (-कः) A bear: see भीरुक ।
